description: At a magic chalkboard, Robo, Duck and Turtle draw the pre-writing strokes from a green start dot: a standing line (top to bottom) that rains, a lying line (left to right) that becomes a road, a slanted line slide, a circle round the c way that rolls away as a ball, a rainbow curve, wavy sea waves and a zigzag crown. Then lines make a house and the letters L, T and O.

youtube.title: Lines and Curves! Pre-Writing Practice for Preschool | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Trace along with Robo, Duck and Turtle at the magic chalkboard! Every line starts at the green dot: a standing line goes top to bottom, a lying line goes left to right, a slanted line slides down, and a circle starts at the top and goes round the c way. Each line comes alive: rain, a road, a slide, a rolling ball, a rainbow curve, sea waves for a boat and a zigzag crown. Then lines join up to make a house and the letters L, T and O. Slow and steady makes a neat line!

Try it at home with a grown-up: draw each line in the air with your whole arm, then trace them with one finger in a tray of salt or sand, then with a crayon on big paper from a start dot. Look for lines and circles around you (a door edge, a plate, a curtain). Crayons and salt are not for eating; wash your hands after the tray.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: A magic chalkboard. Watch my chalk dot.
Every line can make something. Let's draw them all!
A standing line. Hmm... I'll start at the bottom.
No, Robo! Start at the top!
Oops! Thank you. Start at the top.
Ready... start at the dot... go!
Stand up tall, like a standing line!
A lying line. Start at the dot, on the left.
A road! Vroom, left to right!
Lie down flat, like a lying line!
A slanted line. Top to bottom, on a slant.
Lean over, like a slanted line!
A circle. Start at the top, and go round this way.
Oops, a gap! Join it up.
You joined it up! A circle!
Make a big circle with your arms!
A curve. Up, over the hill, and down.
A rainbow is a curve. It is part of a circle of light!
A wavy line. Up and down, smooth and round.
Waves! The boat goes up and down!
Sea waves go up and down, like a wavy line.
A zigzag. Up, down, up, down. Sharp points!
Wavy is smooth. Zigzag is pointy!
Lines can make pictures! Four lines...
Long ago, people drew lines and circles on cave walls!
Lines make letters, too. A standing line...
A lying line, and a standing line...
One. Where does a standing line start? Top, or bottom?
Two. Which way does a lying line go?
Three. Which is smooth: wavy, or zigzag?
